name: Norfolk
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Norfolk for 2026, and here is what he found: 25 family events, 16 of them free. The magic runs from November 8 (Dominion Energy Garden of Lights) through January 4 (Garden of Lights and Skate the Riverwalk), with Breakfast with Santa at Harbor Park (December 5), the Ocean View Holiday Tree Lighting (December 6) and Holidays in the Wild at the Virginia Zoo (December 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Norfolk

  • 25 Christmas events for kids in Norfolk
  • 16 free events, including the Holiday Yule Log Bonfire, the Ocean View Holiday Tree Lighting and Winter Twilight at The Hermitage
  • Meet Santa: Yule Log Bonfire at Town Point Park, Ocean View Tree Lighting and Breakfast with Santa at Harbor Park
  • Parades and tree lightings: Ocean View Holiday Tree Lighting (December 6)
  • Lights and skating: Garden of Lights, Winterfest on the Wisconsin and Skate the Riverwalk
  • Season: November 8 to January 4, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Norfolk families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Virginia Beach, which covers the Bayport Credit Union Holiday Trail of Lights at the Virginia Aquarium, Planes, Trains and Santa at the Military Aviation Museum and the Snow Globe Spectacular at Town Center.
